v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Suávi iugo tuo * domináre, Dómine, in médio inimicórum tuórum.
text.en: Put thy easy yoke * upon all mankind, O Lord, and be thou ruler, even in the midst of thine enemies.

text.la: Miséricors * et miserátor Dóminus: escam dedit timéntibus se.
text.en: This merciful * and gracious Lord hath given Meat unto them that fear him.

text.la: Exórtum est * in ténebris lumen rectis; miséricors et miserátor Dóminus.
text.en: Unto the godly * there ariseth up light in the darkness, even the Lord merciful and gracious.

text.la: Quid retríbuam * Dómino pro ómnibus quæ retríbuit mihi?
text.en: What reward shall I give * unto the Lord for all the benefits that he hath done unto me?

text.la: Apud Dóminum * propitiátio est et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
text.en: With the Lord * there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

text.la: Fratres: Mihi ómnium sanctórum mínimo data est grátia hæc, in géntibus evangelizáre investigábiles divítias Christi; et illumináre omnes, quæ sit dispensátio sacraménti abscónditi a sǽculis in Deo.
text.en: Brethren: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ; and to make all men see what is the fellowship of the Mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God.

v.la: Tóllite iugum meum super vos et díscite a me.
v.en: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me.

r.la: Quia mitis sum et húmilis Corde.
r.en: For I am meek and lowly in Heart.

text.la: Ignem * veni míttere in terram, et quid volo nisi ut accendátur?
text.en: I am come to send Fire * on the earth, and what will I, but that it be kindled?

text.la: Deus, qui nobis in Corde Fílii tui, nostris vulneráto peccátis, infinítos dilectiónis thesáuros misericórditer largíri dignáris; concéde, quǽsumus, ut illi devótum pietátis nostræ præstántes obséquium, dignæ quoque satisfactiónis exhibeámus offícium.
text.en: O God, who hast suffered the Heart of thy Son to be wounded by our sins, and in that very Heart hast bestowed on us the abundant riches of thy love: grant that the devout homage of our hearts, which we render unto him, may of thy mercy be deemed a recompence acceptable in thy sight.

office.title: Feria V infra Hebd II post Octavam Pentecostes
